title: SkillUsageEvent
description: Runtime-neutral normalized observation event. One JSON object per line in event logs; `observe` emits the same shape for transcript/db-derived events. Never contains conversation bodies, command lines, or tool output — prompts are represented by prompt_hash (SHA-256 hex) only.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 preferred; may be empty when the source record lacks one

prompt_hash.description: SHA-256 hex of the prompt text; never the text itself

emitted.description: Whether the recommendation reached the model/context

reason.description: Machine-readable reason when emitted=false or for diagnostics

skill_digest.description: SHA-256 of SKILL.md content when a full read was verified

detection.description: native_invocation: runtime-native skill mechanism fired; file_read: SKILL.md content read with corroborating evidence; path_reference: SKILL.md path referenced by a read-like access, content unverified; inferred: weaker heuristic (e.g. runtime skill-selection list); mention: name/path referenced without read evidence; applied: reserved for explicit application confirmation

tool.description: Runtime tool name that produced the observation
